itemized.notes: Handwritten form, photocopy ('COPY' stamp). The Complete Mailing Address column is EMPTY on every Schedule A row (filer left it blank), so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. Three of the eight Schedule A rows are contributions from the candidate MARK CROCKETT himself; two of them pair date-for-date and figure-for-figure with Schedule B vendor payments (8/13 Modern Display 5,125.00 and 9/3 Valley Journal 1,400.00), a self-funding/reimbursement pattern - recorded, not interpreted. Contribution amounts are written without cents (6,000 / 100 / 7,500 ...) and are kept verbatim; expenditure amounts carry cents, two of them as a superscript over a rule (5,125.00 and 7,500.00). The Occupation AND Employer column is filled on four Schedule A rows; the row contract has no field for it so it is recorded in those rows' notes.
